items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: Alvin Jones can just take, Max, just take the cymbals and sit down and blow you away.

ctx.x: A good drummer makes a good drum sound.

Alvin Jones can just take, Max, just take the cymbals and sit down and blow you away. You know, something, you know. A tub, a Lord box, anything, you know. It's the guy that's buying, you know. But it blends in, you know. It's not like a bad horn.
Yes, so you're... I'm trying to say, does the, what's the, what's the, the relationship between the snare and the bass?
